name: MultiLang
description: 多语言：在预设语言间切换，整体翻译文本字段（缺失字段保留原文降级）。

config.name: detect
config.description: 可选的运行时语言探测

config.name: translations
config.description: 各语言翻译（顶层字段整体覆盖）

example: withResumePlugins(ResumeCore, [createMultiLangPlugin({ locales:[{code:'zh',label:'中'},{code:'en',label:'EN'}], translations: { en: { basics:{ name:'John', title:'Engineer', contacts:[] } } } })])
